title: Commercial Docking Facilities
previewText: Commercial docking facilities are listed in Use Group IV(B) in Sections 32-14 and 42-14. Such uses are permitted as-of-right in all districts set forth in the Use Groups and are subject to the accessory off-street parking and passenger loading requirements of Sections 62-43 and 62-462 of this Chapter.
